arcs.title: The Briefcase
arcs.summary: Day 2: Three Ministry departments have filed competing claims of ownership — the Department of Mysteries, the Office of Unclassified Artefact Management, and an unnamed department that officially does not exist. An unattributed memo suggesting someone open the briefcase has circulated; its author is unknown (Lucy is the leading theory). The briefcase has not moved. The hum has deepened by a minor third. Day 3 should escalate toward an opening attempt — perhaps an Unspeakable is dispatched, or a junior clerk acts on the memo and reports something before the report is confiscated, or the briefcase briefly opens of its own accord and closes before anyone can confirm what they saw.
